//: Generic micro tile container (prototype, sky130A only): a 1x1 project with four slots.
The slots are placeholder macros (tt_micro_tile_slot, written by micro_container.py) with
the interface every micro tile has. Hardened once per shuttle build, like the chip ROM:
python micro_container.py placeholder micro_container && python -m librelane micro_container/config.json
Absolute die size, no rings, small margins: as for every Tiny Tapeout project
Antenna: OpenROAD's met3/met4 thickness (tech LEF 0.8 um) is 5 % below Magic's (0.845 um) and the
post-route check has no margin; repair with 50 % margin so that the container is also Magic-clean
with nothing behind the slot pins (the worst case for every micro tile)

pdk::sky130A.//: The slots sit in the four corners, pins facing a 20.24 um channel (right column mirrored)
Keep the container's cells and rails clear of the slots
Vertical met4 stripes cross the horizontal met3 stripes of the micro tiles: via3 there
li1 to met3 inside a slot belong to the micro tile, pins excepted (also in the slot LEF).
Antenna: the slot LEF leaves the container no way to a pin but a via3 from met4 (micro_container.py)
